harness.role: Nightly, pull each connected club's season from Football Web Pages with that club's OWN key, and leave the club its last good season when the feed fails.
context_sources: supabase://ghkazaxuznltpxfzvxny/club_feed_keys (RLS on, no policies: service role only)
https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/api (FWP-API-Key header, 10 requests a minute per key)
constraints: Injury Time holds no key of its own: a club without a key is not synced, never borrowed another's
one club at a time, at most three requests per club, inside the 10 a minute limit
writes only what the feed publishes: results, fixtures, standings, progress, players.external_stats
a failed sync never empties a season: the last good rows stay, the failure is written to that club's key row
never prints or returns a key
harness.done_when: every club with a key has last_sync_at today and a last_sync_note that is either 'synced N results' or the reason it failed, and the run returns done, nothing-to-do (no keys) or degraded naming each failed club

comms.actuation: club_feed_keys.last_sync_note, shown to that club's staff on /club; the run's own 503 on failure, visible in Vercel's cron log
comms.note: no email, no notification row: the club page is where a manager looks when their table looks wrong

capabilities.db_write: results, fixtures, league_standings, league_progress, players.external_stats, clubs.season_*, club_feed_keys.last_sync_*

permissions.note: route refuses without CRON_SECRET; keys sit in a table with RLS on and no policies, so only the service role reads them; each club is synced with its own key and every write keyed to that club's id

tenancy.note: one key per club, used only for that club's rows; a key is never tried against another club

audit.note: last_sync_at and last_sync_note per club; the upstream response itself is not kept, the rows it produced are

actions.idempotency_key: upserts on natural keys: results (club_id, match_date, opponent), standings (club_id, as_of, team), progress (club_id, match_no); fixtures insert only the missing ones
